clue.text: Half of carafe mum put out rubbished as worthless residue (12, two words)

indicators.note: something rubbished is trashed and knocked about, so the letters lose their order
asks for only the first three of the six letters in the following word

parts.note: the front half of the six-letter word
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone empties out a half-finished carafe of mum, a kind of beer, and throws it away as dregs.
explanation.walkthrough: Mum is an old strong beer, which makes the surface plausible. CAPUT MORTUUM is Latin for 'dead head', the alchemists' word for what is left after distillation.
explanation.definitionFit: The alchemists' term names the useless dregs left behind after a substance is distilled or sublimed.

clue.text: Baptismal garb in church, a variety of school trim

clue.text: Lord in the wars with a quibble about separate piece of armour

the letters of the word rearranged

explanation.surface: A battered nobleman back from battle quibbles over a single piece of his armour.
